targeted_edits.prompt: Edit ONLY the short shift labels in this infographic. Preserve all other text, composition, illustrations, colors, proportions and style exactly. Every illustrated roster/calendar currently has three headers 「早」「中」「晚」, and the three colored badges beside 「3 個班別」 also say 「早」「中」「晚」. These are wrong for this teaching handout. Replace ALL occurrences, in the same left-to-right order, with the exact actual names 「白班」「小夜」「大夜」. Make these short Chinese labels large and legible within the existing colored header areas, widening header labels only if necessary. Do not change counts, other text or any arrows. Keep the image 3:2. No other changes.

Make a precise correction to this teaching infographic. Preserve all layout, palette, illustrations, large titles, card numbering, and text not specified here. Card 4 has incorrect shift times: replace the left 「小夜 22:00–06:00」 with exact 「小夜 16:00–00:00」, and the right 「大夜 06:00–14:00」 with exact 「隔天大夜 00:00–08:00」. These two shifts touch at midnight, so keep both 「休息 0 小時」 labels and the arrow. Card 6 has an incorrect example table: the TOP and BOTTOM rows must both say 「護理人員」 (the valid category); the MIDDLE red highlighted row must say 「護理師」 (the deliberately invalid category in this lesson). Keep warning arrow pointing to the middle red row. Do not add times anywhere else or change other cards. All text in Traditional Chinese. Keep 3:2 ratio.
